svg.text: ⌀2.2 through; counterbore ⌀4.4 x 2.4 deep from below
Scale 1.5:1 plans, 2:1 section, 8:1 detail, on A3. Dimensions in mm, computed from the model.
Datum A: back-left outer corner seen from above. X to the right, Y toward the front.
3-axis, two setups: inside up, then underside up.
Every pocket corner is R1.5: a 3 mm end mill reaches them all.
45 degree chamfers: 0.8 on the underside rim, 0.3 on the seam rim, the flank and ends of the lap ridges, the USB lead-in.
General tolerance: ISO 2768-m is a proposal. Nothing has been made or measured.
